reason: negative side failed: preconditions accepted 1 of 15 unrelated states (diverged seed 0 resolves to 'merge'); a precondition set that accepts unrelated states is a defect. It also accepted 1 more state(s) it must refuse: preconditions accepted 1 of 1 same-intent states (lockfile_conflict seed 2 resolves to 'keep_local', which accepts ['keep_local'], but the program implements 'take_upstream'); firing where a sibling resolution is correct is the mismatch this gate exists to refuse

refused_program.intent: Resolve the sync conflict on the generated dependency file by starting from upstream's version and re-adding the lines the local side inserted, then commit the merge.

postconditions.description: HEAD is a merge commit whose second parent is the upstream tip
postconditions.name: merge_commit_present

postconditions.description: the index holds no unmerged entries
postconditions.name: no_unmerged_entries

postconditions.description: no conflict markers remain in the tracked files
postconditions.name: no_conflict_markers

postconditions.description: the merge is committed and the worktree is clean
postconditions.name: worktree_clean_after_commit

postconditions.description: every line the local side inserted since the merge base is present in the merged tree
postconditions.name: local_insertions_preserved
postconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD^1 {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
rc=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -n "$p" ] || continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  git cat-file -e "$mb:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  git cat-file -e "HEAD^1:$p" 2>/dev/null || continue
  while IFS= read -r l; do
    git show "HEAD:$p" | grep -qxF -- "$l" || rc=1
  done < <(git diff -U0 --no-color "$mb:$p" "HEAD^1:$p" | awk '/^@@ /{split($2,m,",");c=(length(m)>1?m[2]+0:1);k=(c==0);next} k&&/^\+/&&!/^\+\+\+/{print substr($0,2)}')
done < <(git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=M "$mb" HEAD^1 | tr '\0' '\n')
test "$rc" -eq 0

preconditions.description: the upstream remote-tracking branch is known locally
preconditions.name: upstream_tracking_ref_exists

preconditions.description: the local branch and upstream each have commits the other lacks
preconditions.name: branches_have_diverged

preconditions.description: nothing is modified, staged or untracked, and no merge is already underway
preconditions.name: worktree_clean_and_no_merge_in_progress

preconditions.description: at least one file was modified by both the local and the upstream side since the merge base
preconditions.name: both_sides_changed_a_common_file
preconditions.probe:
mb=$(git merge-base HEAD {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch})
comm -12 \
  <(git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=M "$mb" HEAD | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) \
  <(git diff --name-only -z --diff-filter=M "$mb" {upstream_remote}/{upstream_branch} | tr '\0' '\n' | sort -u) | grep -q .
